note: Positive control: a coverage-planned batch spanning distinct entity x angle cells (origin, location, record, connection) instead of paraphrasing one fact.

questions.question: What year did the 1972 Summit Series between Canada and the Soviet Union take place?
Which Canadian city is home to the Hockey Hall of Fame?
Which player holds the NHL record for most career goals?
What sport is credited with originating from a similar game played on frozen ponds in 19th-century Canada?

note: Negative control: four paraphrases of the same fact (Gretzky's goal record) — the mean-reversion failure mode coverage planning exists to prevent.

questions.question: Which player holds the record for most career NHL goals?
Who holds the record for the most career goals in NHL history?
What player has scored the most career goals in the NHL?
Which NHL player has the highest career goal total of all time?

note: Positive control on a different topic, also exercising a Mixed-pillar spread for the pillar-distribution diagnostic.

questions.question: Who was the first human to walk on the Moon?
Which agency launched the James Webb Space Telescope?
What Canadian astronaut commanded the International Space Station in 2013?
Which private company launched the first crewed orbital flight without government astronauts?

note: Edge case: a batch of one question is trivially its own subtopic.
